535:     #[inductive(initialize)]
536:     fn initialize_inductive(post: Self, buffer_size: nat, num_replicas: nat, contents: Map<int, StoredType<DT>>, cell_ids: Seq<CellId>,  unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>, ) {
